description: Add time to an active hourly parking session. No API key needed: ask the driver for the phone code on their receipt or pass, the last 3 characters of their plate, and how many hours to add (0.5 to 8, in half-hour steps). The answer is the price, the new end time and a pay_url to the driver's session page: send the driver there to pay. Nothing is charged and the end time doesn't move until they pay. Any mismatch gets one answer, SESSION_NOT_FOUND. With an API key (sessions:write), session_id and session_code extend the session through the API.

extend_hours.description: Hours to add. Ask the driver. Without an API key: 0.5 to 8, in half-hour steps.

phone_code.description: The 6-character phone code printed on the driver's receipt or pass. Ask the driver for it.

plate_last3.description: The last 3 letters or numbers of the license plate parked on the session. Ask the driver for it.

session_id.description: Session id. Without an API key, send it with session_code instead of the phone code.

name: extend_session
title: Extend a parking session
